about_hero_description: We believe fashion can be beautiful, functional, and ethical at the same time.
about_mission_title: More than a bag, a movement.
about_mission_paragraph_1: At {{company}}, we were born with a simple yet ambitious mission: eliminate single-use plastic bags in Colombia without sacrificing style.
about_mission_paragraph_2: What began in 2024 as a small workshop in Medellín has become a community of conscious people choosing quality over quantity. Every tote bag we make carries hours of dedication, carefully selected materials, and a commitment to reducing our environmental footprint.
about_eco_description: We use only certified organic cotton and water-based inks, free of chemicals harmful to the planet.
about_fair_trade_description: We work directly with local artisans, ensuring fair wages and safe, ethical working conditions.
about_durability_description: We design products to last for years, not seasons. One of our tote bags replaces up to 500 plastic bags per year.
about_join_description: Do you have questions about our process or want to collaborate with us? We'd love to hear from you.

corporate_timing_description: Efficient logistics management to meet your delivery deadlines, whether for events or retail restocking.
corporate_cta_description: Tell us about your project and receive a customized quote in less than 24 business hours.
b2b_description: Turn your company's merchandising into a statement of sustainability. We customize premium tote bags with your visual identity and integrated QR technology.
b2b_premium_description: 100% organic cotton or high-resistance canvas. Long-lasting DTF or screen printing that won't crack.
b2b_qr_description: Each bag includes a scannable QR integrated into the design that takes your customers directly to your WhatsApp, Instagram, or website.
b2b_logistics_description: Production capacity of +1000 units per week. Insured shipping across the country with business tracking.
